title.zh: The 'Largest Pure-Play' XRP Treasury Is About to Go Public
title.en: The 'Largest Pure-Play' XRP Treasury Is About to Go Public

current_state.zh: Evernorth won shareholder approval for its merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II and will list on Nasdaq as ticker XRPN on Oct. 8, creating a publicly traded pure-play XRP treasury that raised more than $1 billion with backing from Ripple, Pantera and Kraken.
